runtime.connectionModel: one serial-connected flight controller at a time
runtime.mavlinkDialect: ardupilotmega (includes common messages used by PX4)
runtime.safety: Calibration commands never arm or run motors. Remove propellers before hardware setup.

callingConvention.tauri: import { invoke } from '@tauri-apps/api/core'; then await invoke(command, arguments)
callingConvention.argumentNaming: JavaScript argument keys use camelCase. Rust responses are serialized as camelCase.
callingConvention.errors: A Rust Result::Err rejects the invoke Promise with its string message.

endpoints.returns: BackendInfo: version, OS, CPU architecture, flight stacks, transports, and motorCommandsEnabled=false

endpoints.notes: Template diagnostic command; it does not communicate with hardware.

responseFields.portName: OS port such as /dev/ttyACM0 or COM3
responseFields.portType: human-readable USB, Bluetooth, PCI, or unknown type
responseFields.isLikelyFlightController: true for USB ports and common ACM/USB/COM names

endpoints.returns: DroneStatus only after an ArduPilot or PX4 heartbeat verifies the link
endpoints.timeout: 5 seconds waiting for a supported autopilot heartbeat
errors: port is busy or permission is denied

endpoints.returns: AutoConnectResult with selected portName, baudRate, verified DroneStatus, and attempted combinations
endpoints.behavior: Tries likely USB/ACM/USB/COM flight-controller ports. It succeeds only after receiving an ArduPilot or PX4 heartbeat.
endpoints.notes: Manual connect remains available for unusual serial adapters or baud rates.

responseFields.connected: true only while a supported autopilot heartbeat is current

endpoints.returns: Latest sensorHealth, imu, attitude, gps, battery and lastMessageMs values; fields are null until received
Feature flags compiled from calibration_config.yaml, supported stacks, and safety flags

firmwareBehavior.ArduPilot: starts MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_CALIBRATION, receives MAV_CMD_ACCELCAL_VEHICLE_POS prompts, and requires confirm_accelerometer_orientation
firmwareBehavior.PX4: starts MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_CALIBRATION and detects stable orientations automatically from PX4 prompts

preconditions: vehicle is motionless in the prompted orientation
errors: PX4 does not use this confirmation endpoint

endpoints.completion: Tracks acknowledgements/status text; also detects the ArduPilot gyro unhealthy-to-healthy calibration cycle.

firmwareBehavior.ArduPilot: uses MAV_CMD_DO_START_MAG_CAL with retry and autosave; tracks MAG_CAL_PROGRESS and MAG_CAL_REPORT

endpoints.notes: The default ArduPilot start requests autosave, so this is mainly available for explicit/manual workflows.
Some firmware versions require parameter-based RC calibration and will return MAV_RESULT_UNSUPPORTED; the session reports that rejection instead of claiming success.

preconditions: vehicle motionless on a verified level surface
endpoints.returns: CalibrationStart for the level-horizon form of MAV_CMD_PREFLIGHT_CALIBRATION

responseFields.instruction: current user-facing firmware prompt or backend instruction

endpoints.returns: Up to 200 COMMAND_ACK, STATUSTEXT, accelerometer-position, MAG_CAL_PROGRESS, and MAG_CAL_REPORT events from the current connection
running, bindAddress, websocketPath, and lastError for the attitude WebSocket

serverMessages.rate: up to the requested ATTITUDE rate (20 Hz)
